name: Reverse Text
summary: Reverse characters, words, or lines in any text string.
description: Flip text backwards by character, reverse word order while keeping spacing, or reverse line order in multi-line input. Useful for puzzles, testing, and quick transforms.

faqs.question: Unicode characters?
faqs.answer: Character mode reverses by Unicode code point for most everyday text and emoji.

faqs.question: Word mode?
faqs.answer: Reverses the order of words but keeps original spacing between them.
